channel.title: Looking for Greenlight | The girl and her mysterious guardian
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "Looking for Greenlight | The girl and her mysterious guardian" - A woman comes into contact with an invisible entity, resulting in strange events.

item.title: Re: Looking for Greenlight | The girl and her mysterious guardian
item.content:encoded: I’m imagining for the readers to be both sympathetic to the entity and the woman.

item.title: Re: Forum Criticism Team - Captain Post
item.content:encoded:
Thank you for your feedback.
I am imagining that anything that could harm the girl is prevented by the entity. So if someone tried to shoot her in the head, the entity would stop it from happening. So I think of the foundation as being afraid of what would happen if she was ever killed, due to the uncertainty of what the entity would do.
Your suggestion is actually interesting, maybe the entity’s connection to her makes her permanently sick, but it can’t do anything about it.

item.title: Re: Forum Criticism Team - Captain Post
item.content:encoded:
I think I misinterpreted this idea a little. On a second read, it's not that similar to the other SCP, but I still find the "needing to sacrifice humans to feed the entity" part a bit too generic. Also, what's preventing the Foundation from just killing the girl? Will the entity latch on to someone else? I think this needs a bit more detail.

If I had to make a suggestion, I think this would be more interesting if the entity was making the girl sick but killing everyone who tried to separate it from her. You could even add in a more sympathetic angle for the entity - maybe it really doesn't want to hurt the girl or anyone else, but it just naturally causes death? Something of that type would interest me more.

item.title: Re: Looking for Greenlight | The girl and her mysterious guardian
item.content:encoded:
This is still a little raw, but it can become a nice entry. My main concern is that there isn't much of a narrative here.

You have to define what you want the readers to feel: angry at the entity, sorry for the woman, angry at the woman, afraid of the entity? You can take this narrative on different directions depending on what emotion you want to evoke.

The overall idea is a little basic, reminiscent of many ghost/possession/cursed entities stories, I suggest investing on the emotional aspect to make it more unique.

item.title: Looking for Greenlight | The girl and her mysterious guardian
item.content:encoded:
Seeking greenlight: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator pitch: An invisible entity is connected to a human female.

Hook/ Attention-Grabber: The entity needs a human sacrifice every 42 days. If the 42 days deadline passes, the human female becomes ill (nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, etc) until a few days later, where the entity will go on a killing spree of any humans in its general area.

Central Narrative: The entity first appeared to the human female when she was in a park. After this encounter, the human became infatuated with the entity, resulting in it staying by her side at all times. 42 days after she met the creature, she became sick and soon dozens of people were dying, which caught the eye of the foundation.
After the foundation had made contact with the SCP, the female was taken into custody and her family and friends were told she died in a car crash.

Additional notes: I want the focus of the article to be the mystery of the entity and what it’s goals are.
